stories.title: 📄 Research Report — Building No. 10 North (re-state.co.uk)
stories.summary: No 10 North's mission is to strengthen the executive core of Government while devolving power to subnational government. Proposed structure: four core units (Devolution, Subnational Investment & Growth, System Democratisation, Local Public Services Innovation) plus a Transformation Directorate. Flagship recommendation: let mayoral strategic authorities retain 2.5p of locally raised income tax instead of the integrated settlement. Warns against symbolism-only, too-small (vs. Darlington Economic Campus benchmark), business-as-usual, or substitute-for-Whitehall-reform outcomes. Sets a 'first nine weeks' implementation roadmap.
